annotations.title: Check Provision In Force on Date

description:
Whether one unit was legally in force on a given date.

`in_force` is true, false, or null when the corpus cannot tell. `outcome`
'deterministic' is from the portal's own events or edition history, anything
else from AI review of the text.

An undated URN asks about the provision; a dated one about that version of
its text: false once replaced (`scope` 'version', `version_in_force_urn`).

`decided_for_provision` false: the answer is the act's, possibly wrong for an
article inserted or deleted mid-life.

`source: 'no_force_event'`: none ever recorded -- read `document_status_name`.
name: ua_law__get_unit_in_force
